description: This file defines a custom exception class 'OAuth2' within the SuiteCRM OAuth2 exception namespace. It extends a base exception class and customizes its constructor, as well as providing methods for detailed messages and log level information.

classes.name: OAuth2
classes.description: Custom exception class for OAuth2 related errors in SuiteCRM, providing specific messaging and logging levels.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the OAuth2 exception with a message, code, and optional previous exception, prepending '[OAuth2]' to the message.

methods.name: getDetail
methods.description: Returns a string indicating an unhandled exception in the SuiteCRM OAuth2 server.

methods.name: getLogLevel
methods.description: Returns the log level for this exception, set to ERROR.
